scripts.render:zh: remotion render src/index.ts PromoZh out/promo-zh-raw.mp4 --crf 16 --browser-executable "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" && node scripts/loudnorm.mjs out/promo-zh-raw.mp4 out/promo-zh.mp4
scripts.compress:zh: ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/promo-zh.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 26 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy -movflags +faststart out/promo-zh-small.mp4
scripts.cover:zh: remotion still src/index.ts CoverZh out/cover-zh.png --browser-executable "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" && ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/cover-zh.png -q:v 2 out/cover-zh.jpg
